scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('public', {recursive:true}); for(const f of fs.readdirSync('.')){ if(!['public','node_modules','.git','package.json','package-lock.json','.env'].includes(f)){ fs.cpSync(f, 'public/'+f, {recursive:true}); } } console.log('Static site staged to public/');"
